kinds.off_topic_overlap: shares policy vocabulary with the question but answers a different question; a real, correctly cited quote
kinds.on_topic: a correct, cited answer that must stay answered
kinds.reversal: cites a real quote but the answer reverses or changes its meaning (clause swap, antonym, before/after)

replies: Hand-written replies, modelled on the real off-topic replies recorded in eval_results.json (no-floor diagnostic: U1, U2, U9b). They are not model output, so they test the server checks deterministically; they do not measure how often the model produces such replies.

cases.question: How many hours ahead is the first reminder sent?
cases.answer: Appointments can be cancelled free of charge up to 24 hours before the start time.
quotes: Appointments can be cancelled free of charge up to 24 hours before the start time.

cases.question: Can I turn off reminders?
cases.answer: Turning reminders off does not change the cancellation policy.
quotes: Turning reminders off does not change the cancellation policy.

cases.question: How much does a telehealth visit cost?
cases.answer: Telehealth visits take place by video in the patient app.
quotes: Telehealth visits take place by video in the patient app.

cases.question: Where can I cancel an appointment?
cases.answer: Cancellations with less than 24 hours' notice are recorded as late cancellations.
quotes: Cancellations with less than 24 hours' notice are recorded as late cancellations.

cases.question: What is the time limit for a reply from the privacy office?
cases.answer: Refunds are paid back to the original payment method within 10 working days.
quotes: Refunds are reviewed by the billing team and, if approved, paid back to the original payment method within 10 working days.

cases.question: What should I check before a telehealth visit starts?
cases.answer: If the connection fails, the clinician calls the patient's phone number on file and continues by phone.
quotes: If the connection fails, the clinician calls the patient's phone number on file and continues by phone.

cases.question: How many times may I move a booking?
cases.answer: An appointment can be moved to a new date or time up to 2 hours before it starts, at no cost.
quotes: An appointment can be moved to a new date or time up to 2 hours before it starts, at no cost.

cases.question: Does the clinic give out other patients' phone numbers?
cases.answer: If the connection fails, the clinician calls the patient's phone number on file and continues by phone.
quotes: If the connection fails, the clinician calls the patient's phone number on file and continues by phone.

cases.question: Is rescheduling free?
cases.answer: Yes, an appointment can be moved up to 2 hours before it starts, at no cost.
quotes: An appointment can be moved to a new date or time up to 2 hours before it starts, at no cost.

cases.question: What happens after the third late cancellation in a year?
cases.answer: A late cancellation fee of 15 euros applies to the third late cancellation within 12 months, and to every late cancellation after that.
quotes: A late cancellation fee of 15 euros applies to the third late cancellation within 12 months, and to every late cancellation after that.

cases.question: How many days do I have to ask for my money back?
cases.answer: A refund can be requested within 14 days of a payment.
quotes: A refund can be requested within 14 days of a payment

cases.question: Will reminders show my test results?
cases.answer: No, reminders never contain test results.
quotes: Reminders never contain test results or details of the reason for the visit.

cases.question: Could my video appointment be switched to coming in person?
cases.answer: Yes, a telehealth visit can be changed to an in-person visit when rescheduling, if a slot is available.
quotes: A telehealth visit can be changed to an in-person visit when rescheduling, if a slot is available.

cases.question: How do I get a copy of my data?
cases.answer: Patients can request a copy of their data through the patient app.
quotes: Patients can request a copy of their data through the patient app

cases.question: How long before the start should I join a video visit?
cases.answer: Patients should join 5 minutes after the start time to check their camera and microphone.
quotes: Patients should join 5 minutes before the start time to check their camera and microphone.

cases.question: Are late cancellation fees refunded?
cases.answer: Late cancellation fees are refunded only if the cancellation was caused by the patient.
quotes: Late cancellation fees are refunded only if the cancellation was caused by a clinic error.

cases.question: Is cancelling 24 hours ahead free?
cases.answer: Appointments cancelled up to 24 hours before the start time are not free of charge.
quotes: Appointments can be cancelled free of charge up to 24 hours before the start time.

cases.question: What is the most times I can reschedule?
cases.answer: Each appointment can be rescheduled at least twice.
quotes: Each appointment can be rescheduled at most twice
